scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token you paste into the extension once per browser to register it. Use a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables LLM categorizing with Claude Haiku. Leave empty to use rules + learned categories only.
